mapper.select: SELECT a.REQUST_ID , a.OCCRRNC_DE , a.URL , a.RQESTER_IP , a.RQESTER_ID , b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.REQUST_ID = #{requstId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT a.REQUST_ID , a.OCCRRNC_DE , a.URL , a.RQESTER_IP , a.RQESTER_ID , b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.URL LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY a.OCCRRNC_DE DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(a.REQUST_ID) as cnt FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.URL LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
mapper.sql:
SELECT a.SESN_ID, MIN(a.OCCRRNC_DE) AS BGN_DT, MAX(a.OCCRRNC_DE) AS END_DT, COUNT(*) AS REQ_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT a.URL) AS PAGE_CNT,
MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.RQESTER_ID),'')) AS RQESTER_ID, MAX(a.RQESTER_IP) AS RQESTER_IP, MAX(a.DVICE_SE) AS DVICE_SE, MAX(a.BROWSER_NM) AS BROWSER_NM, MAX(a.URL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY a.OCCRRNC_DE) AS LAST_URL FROM COMTNWEBLOG a WHERE TRIM(a.SESN_ID) IS NOT NULL
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE >= TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE <= TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND a.DVICE_SE = #{searchDviceSe}
GROUP BY a.SESN_ID

SELECT SUBSTR(s.SESN_ID, 1, 8) AS SESN_ID, s.RQESTER_ID, b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM, s.RQESTER_IP,
TO_CHAR(s.BGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS BGN_DT, TO_CHAR(s.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_DT, ROUND((s.END_DT - s.BGN_DT) * 1440) AS DUR_MIN, s.REQ_CNT, s.PAGE_CNT, s.DVICE_SE, s.BROWSER_NM, s.LAST_URL FROM ( ) s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON b.ESNTL_ID = s.RQESTER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON b.ESNTL_ID = s.RQESTER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY SELECT TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE,'YYYYMMDD') , b.URL , COUNT(b.OCCRRNC_DE) AS RDCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT c.OCCRRNC_DE FROM COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY c WHERE c.OCCRRNC_DE = TO_CHAR((SYSDATE - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') ) AND TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE, 'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR((SYSDATE - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE,'YYYYMMDD') , b.URL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTNWEBLOG WHERE TO_CHAR(OCCRRNC_DE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -120), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.sql: WHERE w.OCCRRNC_DE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND w.OCCRRNC_DE < TO_DATE(#{toDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND w.URL NOT LIKE '%Json.do' AND w.URL NOT LIKE '/WEB-INF/%' AND w.URL <> '/validator.do'

choose.when:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY B.LABEL) > 1 THEN B.LABEL || ' (' || DECODE(B.MENU_SE, 'ADMIN', '관리자', '사용자') || ')' ELSE B.LABEL END AS LABEL, B.CNT, B.UCNT FROM ( SELECT m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NM AS LABEL, MAX(m.MENU_SE) AS MENU_SE, COUNT(*) AS CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(w.RQESTER_ID, w.RQESTER_IP)) AS UCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG w JOIN COMTNPROGRMLIST p ON p.URL = w.URL AND p.PROGRM_FILE_NM <> 'folder' JOIN COMTNMENUINFO m ON m.PROGRM_FILE_NM = p.PROGRM_FILE_NM
GROUP BY m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NM ) B ORDER BY B.CNT DESC, LABEL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30
choose.otherwise:
SELECT AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(w.RQESTER_ID, w.RQESTER_IP)) AS UCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG w
GROUP BY ORDER BY
CNT DESC, LABEL LABEL
